title: Building a bamboo bike | Grow your own bike!
body_html:
"Slashing the time to construct its bamboo road frame from around 70 hours down to just four hours with their new easy build option, the Bamboo Bicycle Club has impressively improved the accessibility of building a bamboo bicycle."

— road.cc, December 2020

"Bamboo Bicycle Club taps into 'the IKEA effect' — that extra bit of affection people reserve for objects they put together themselves."

— Financial Times, September 2025

Grow Your Own Bike: The Bamboo Proposition

The phrase "grow your own bike" captures something fundamental about the bamboo bicycle project. Unlike steel, aluminium, or carbon fibre — all of which require energy-intensive industrial processes to extract and process — bamboo grows from the ground, sequesters carbon as it grows, and can be harvested on a three-to-five year cycle without killing the plant. It is the only structural frame material that is genuinely renewable on a human timescale.

Bamboo culms reach their maximum structural strength at three to four years of growth. A single bamboo plant can yield multiple harvestable culms per season without depleting the root system. This makes bamboo one of the most efficient structural materials on Earth — outperforming steel in tensile strength-to-weight ratio, with natural vibration-damping properties that no manufactured material can replicate.

The Bamboo Bicycle Club's approach takes this material proposition and makes it accessible. You don't need to grow your own bamboo — BBC sources and prepares the culms for you. But the spirit of "grow your own" underpins everything: a handmade bicycle built from a material that grew in the earth, shaped by your own hands, configured to your own body, carrying you through your own rides.

BBC has trained over 4,000 builders across 36 countries since 2012. Workshops run monthly in London, with home build kits available worldwide. Every kit includes all the materials and tools needed to build a complete bamboo bicycle frame — plus full technical support throughout your build.

Building a bamboo bicycle is not just about the finished product. It is about understanding the material, the engineering, and the craft. Builders who come through the BBC process come away with a deeper relationship to their bicycle — and to the natural world that made it possible.
author: James Marr
